titulo: NASA’s Juno Takes Temperature of Jupiter’s Fiery Moon Io
cuerpo: Lee esta historia en español aquí. NASA’s Juno mission has provided the first measurements of the temperature below the surface of Jupiter’s moon Io, revealing significant heating within the shallow subsurface of the most volcanically active world in the solar system.
